subject: GPNR kickoff — generalizable view synthesis
body:
Hi Alina,

Kickoff for the generalizable patch-based neural rendering workstream, from our ECCV oral. GPNR synthesizes novel views by reasoning over patches, and the key property is generalization: one trained model renders unseen scenes without per-scene optimization — which is what makes a product possible here. Per-scene NeRF-style training never fit our latency or cost budget.

Product goal: photoreal asset previews for the internal 3D catalog, rendered on demand. Milestones: JAX/Flax training repro on the IBRNet scene collection by Mar 27, quality-bar assessment mid-April, Q2 wrap and Q3 proposal by May 8.

Milan, Carmen and Csilla are assigned. Staffing and the data/ingestion plan over to you.

Lucia
